sectors.trend: Iron ore faces a structural shakeout obscured by war-driven demand; gold miners (Aurum) expanding West African output; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore consolidation; gold names (GOLD.AX, NGN.AX) and lithium/vanadium plays offer diversification. Macarthur (MCR.AX) bulk test clearance is a positive catalyst

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price declines; CBA and WBC face scrutiny over loyalty-customer pricing loopholes; ASIC whistleblower review targets Big Four accountants
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face credit-cycle headwinds and regulatory overhang; rate-sensitive valuations pressured by RBA hawkishness

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas project fractures exposed; energy transition costs 'running off the rails'; EV adoption accelerating
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, SXG.AX benefit from gas price strength; energy transition cost overhang weighs on utilities; EV shift supports battery-metal miners

sectors.trend: Moderna cancer vaccine rally triggers rare sell rating with 44% projected drop; Ozempic maker in trouble, tablets may substitute; dementia research funding via community campaigns
sectors.implications: CSL.AX relatively insulated; biotech names face volatility; watch for GLP-1 tablet transition impact on injectable incumbents

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals systemic fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure shortfall; Carla Zampatti acquires Brighton retail shop
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) and construction names (WTC.AX, CGC.AX) face demand softening; retail property selective

sectors.trend: Nvidia confirms AI boom persists; HPE CEO notes 'customers buying everything'; Oracle faces earnings test; data centre backlash growing; Australia faces AI worker shortage
sectors.implications: Global tech strength supports ASX tech exposure; local AI talent gap (Pocock) may drive migration policy shifts; data centre opposition a medium-term risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hikes amid weakening housing credit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (WES.AX, WPG.AX); reduce leverage in property-linked equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Construction sector contagion from Bathla collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid high-leverage construction names; monitor ASIC and Worksafe developments
Diversify materials exposure toward gold, lithium, and critical minerals
Maintain sector diversification; monitor One Nation policy positions on mining and energy
Favour gas producers (WDS.AX) over renewables capex-heavy names near-term

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC regulatory action on Big Four accountants
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor audit-quality disclosures; potential reputational spillover to listed clients

opportunities.rationale: Gold output expansion (Aurum) and small-cap momentum (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche) offer hedge against rate uncertainty and iron ore weakness
TMK gas rate surge and Beetaloo project progress support upstream gas cash flows amid transition cost overhang

opportunities.recommendation: Selective consumer defensives on EV shift
opportunities.rationale: EV adoption inflection supports auto-parts and charging infrastructure; fuel-cost sensitivity drives structural demand shift

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to housing-linked and construction equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts, 15% home loan application drop, and Bathla contagion risk create downside asymmetry

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim large-cap bank positions pending RBA decision
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate hike risk compresses net interest margins; ASIC and pricing-loophole scrutiny adds regulatory overhang
Structural shakeout in iron ore could pressure BHP, RIO, FMG earnings even with geopolitical demand support

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower into RBA decision; rate-hike fears and housing credit contraction cap upside. 'Bull case returns' narrative provides floor but is unconvincing without credit stabilisation. Expect volatility around RBA and US Fed pause signals.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and housing stabilises. AI capex supercycle, gold/critical-minerals demand, and EV transition support selective outperformance. Construction and housing remain structural drags. Political uncertainty from One Nation gains adds policy risk.
